sources.verified_angle_summary: At DeepFest 2026, BIOSTAR officially showcased its new EdgeComp MS-NAT4000 compact Edge AI computing system, powered by the NVIDIA Jetson Thor platform. Designed specifically for industrial automation, robotics, and autonomous systems, the EdgeComp systems provide high-density AI performance, on-device Gen-AI capabilities, and real-time sensor processing at the edge. The launch highlights BIOSTAR's expansion into the robotics and autonomous sectors, offering hardware solutions that minimize latency and maximize decision-making speed in demanding environments such as smart manufacturing, smart cities, and smart retail. The systems are showcased at DeepFest Hall 5, Booth H5.C28, and represent a significant leap in enabling next-generation industrial applications without relying on cloud connectivity.
sources.verified_key_facts: BIOSTAR showcased its EdgeComp MS-NAT4000 and MS-NAT5000 systems at DeepFest 2026; The systems are powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor and Orin platforms; They are designed for edge AI workloads in smart manufacturing, smart cities, and smart retail; The hardware supports real-time sensor processing and on-device Gen-AI for robotics and autonomous systems; BIOSTAR's exhibition is located at DeepFest Hall 5, Booth H5.C28, and Hall 3, Booth H3.C190-10; The launch emphasizes low-latency decision-making and high-efficiency inference at the edge.
